note: The suite's registry. Every case is listed, passing ones with non_pass []. The gate fails when a listed case does not run, a case runs that is not listed, two cases share an id, fewer than min_cases run, or a case's non-pass verdicts differ from its list in EITHER direction (a new failure is a regression; a fixed one must be removed here in the PR that fixes it). Lowering min_cases or removing an entry needs a reason in the PR.

scan-london-seed-traps.why: Agent gap found by this case: for a London request, lib/scan/place-agreement.ts returns 'unconfirmed' (not 'mismatch') for a page that names a non-UK city (Paris, Berlin), and the runner holds only on 'mismatch', so a Paris company verifies.
